about: e89: A HELD WITHHOLD NEVER PUSHES A SCRIPT ONTO A DOCUMENT THAT DRAWS THE HELD ELEMENT. The answer without the list decides the lane (the runtime door's own fallback, the cost route, the W9 armed route); the list only narrows the runtime document or refuses the script by name, pine:held-divergence. Every condition, broken once, must turn the 101-case sweep (or the armed-route rail) red.
